lines.text: Every seven years creditors must cancel what a brother owes, though they may collect from a foreigner.
If they obey the LORD, He will bless them so that they lend to many nations but borrow from none.
A man must open his hand to a poor brother and give freely, and the LORD will test him.
A Hebrew sold to you and serving six years must go free in the seventh, remembering slavery in Babylon.
A servant who loves his master and is well off stays, with his ear pierced by an awl, for life.
